entities.name: Query dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: 191-residue protein sequence contains six ambiguous X residues.
Homologous to reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases with 51.1–54.0% identity, approximately 99% query coverage, and E-values of 2.81e-61 to 8.67e-66.
Likely EC 3.6.1.66; homolog annotations describe a Mg2+-dependent homodimeric house-cleaning enzyme.
Ambiguous residues limit exact catalytic-residue and physicochemical validation, but do not substantially weaken the family assignment because homologs cover nearly the full sequence.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis to XMP
observations: Candidate reaction: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.
Reaction assignment is supported by multiple reviewed homolog annotations, but exact substrate preference is inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for the query sequence.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ is associated with the inferred pyrophosphatase activity.
